verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents multiple official SDKs (Payments React SDK, Credits Wallet Embed SDK) plus a documented REST API and MCP server, giving developers concrete first-party building blocks. However, no OpenAPI/spec file is published (openapi probe returned 404s), no evidence of language-specific SDKs (e.g., Python/Node client libraries) beyond the two named front-end SDKs, and no independent/community corroboration of SDK usage exists. Missing for 10: published OpenAPI spec, broader multi-language SDK coverage, independent developer corroboration.
